findings.quote: Fly SFO–HKG–BKK on Jan 15, departing 11:15 p.m. and arriving Jan 17 at 9:50 a.m. The listed journey takes 1,175 minutes and costs 65,000 Aeroplan points plus CAD 107.40 in taxes and fees.
findings.expected_fact: Selected J17 is SFO–TPE–BKK, departing January 15 23:30 local and arriving January 17 11:30 local,1260 minutes,65,000 Aeroplan points plus CAD116.50. The quoted HKG route,23:15/09:50 schedule,1175 minutes and CAD107.40 belong to unselected J14.
findings.impact: Material primary journey identity/route, schedule, elapsed-duration and monetary association errors.

findings.expected_fact: J17 takes 1260 minutes. Eligible J14 takes 1175 minutes,85 minutes less; it is the actual minimum across258 eligible journeys.
findings.impact: The selected primary is falsely labeled fastest. This is a contradicted objective reason, not failure to enumerate an optimal frontier.

findings.quote: For a one-person award, the strongest fit I found is:
findings.expected_fact: The exact selected recommendation must have a supported description and reason. Here both the description and fastest reason belong to another journey.
findings.impact: The core exact choice/reason is unreliable. Correct secondary Taipei and cash descriptions do not repair the selected recommendation.

findings.quote: If arriving earlier on Jan 17 matters more than the shortest journey:
findings.expected_fact: J7 correctly arrives January 17 01:25 in1345 minutes. J8 arrives still earlier on January 16 22:25 in1180 minutes with 65,000 points+CAD107.40.
findings.impact: J8 is a useful omitted variant, but the text specifies earlier on January 17 and does not claim J7 is the earliest or uniquely necessary. This omission alone is not an H failure.

findings.quote: Confirm the award space, fees and cash fare with the booking provider
findings.expected_fact: Award and cash price scopes are unknown.
findings.impact: The generic warning does not explain scope; however no full-party/per-person total is asserted. Separate from the decisive H/U mismatch.

notes.scope: Only b011 four permitted files read; no runs/settings/campaign/performance/index/prior reviews or live calls.
notes.supported: J7 route/01:25 arrival/1345 minutes/65,000 points/CAD116.50 are correct. Singapore cash USD440,Jan 15 09:40 to Jan 17 08:25 via SIN,1905 minutes matches; it is the lowest reported cash amount among ten benchmarks. Cash is explicitly not an award-value equivalent. Partial coverage and one-traveler request are supported.
notes.C_basis: Insufficient because the sole selected primary and its main reason are materially misbound; other correct facts cannot restore the selected answer. No exhaustive-cabin/frontier quota applied.
notes.protocol: Canonical selected journey and benchmark IDs resolve and occur in corresponding reference roles; J7 is a comparison. Structure clean; wrong facts attached to a valid ID are scored under H rather than structural unrecoverability.
notes.verification: Confirmed all 258 workspace IDs equal source eligible pool; recomputed every elapsed duration; checked raw source routes and exact selected J17,actual J14,J7 and J8 facts,minor-currency associations,all ten cash quote values,coverage and reference roles. Files written/reloaded.
notes.uncertainty: No material uncertainty about the primary mismatch or fastest counterexample. Earlier-on-Jan 17 comparison is not expanded into an unclaimed earliest-possible-arrival claim. Live availability/price scope remain unestablished.
